question: Aditya can do (1)/(6)th of a piece of work in 5 days and Bhagawan can do (1)/(5)th of the same work in 11 days.Find the number of days taken to complete the work if both work together. (Rounded off to one decimal place)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Aditya: 1/6 work in 5 days → full work = 30 days

Bhagawan: 1/5 work in 11 days → full work = 55 days

Combined time = (30 × 55)/(30 + 55)

= 1650/85 ≈ 19.4 days

**∴ Answer = 19.4 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Aditya does 1/6 work in 5 days, Bhagawan does 1/5 work in 11 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = LCM of days, Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Days

 
 

 Person/Pipe
 Days
 Total Work
 Efficiency
 
 
 
 

 Aditya
 30
 330
 11
 
 

 Bhagawan
 55
 6
 
 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Combined efficiency = 11 + 6 = 17

⇒ Total time = 330 ÷ 17 ≈ 19.4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 19.4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Method

Assume total work as LCM of individual times to avoid fractions.

Efficiency

Efficiency = Work done per day = Total Work ÷ Days.

Combined Work

When working together, efficiencies are added.

Time Formula

Time = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency.
